title: Low-temperature CO2 methanation over Ni catalysts supported on nanocrystalline CeO2 in an electric field
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10538-10548
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08683C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ryota Yamano, Takuma Higo, Yasushi Sekine
Nickel catalysts supported on nanocrystalline CeO2 exhibit intriguing properties, including high Ni dispersion, a high concentration of lattice oxygen defects in the support, and facile formation of hydroxyl groups on the Ni surface.
